name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Senior Implementation Consultant — AI-First Solution Design & Delivery
summary: Implementation consultant and AI solutions architect with 15+ years across B2B SaaS, MarTech, and agency environments, leading software implementations from discovery and solution design through hands-on build, configuration, and adoption. Designs and deploys autonomous, agentic AI workflows that automate complex business logic and solve real business problems, pairing systems-design thinking with deep platform fluency in CRM, project-management, and collaborative work-management tools. A self-starter and trusted advisor to C-suite stakeholders who leads through ambiguity, manages projects on-time and on-budget, and is based in the Denver metro for the hybrid role.

Own project plans and deliverables end to end, building performance dashboards and reporting as a self-starter who leads through ambiguity.
